text:
Maya (PM): Quick kickoff — proposing a 6-week mini cohort (8–10 customers) to validate our DP onboarding + feedback loop. Goal: fast signal on model/latency tradeoffs and onboarding friction.
Alex (Eng): +1. Do we have capacity constraints for Dedicated vs Private? need to know which model variants to offer.
Maya (PM): Priority = Dedicated + Private. Target customers are infra-heavy (high throughput inference) and product teams with data-sensitivity reqs. If capacity's tight, we'll offer a compatible quantized variant with fallbacks.
Liam (ProdOps): Ops note: onboarding runbook needs a checklist, seed tokens, and a rollback plan. I can own runbook + infra prechecks.
Sasha (Design): We should define 3 success criteria up front: (1) 80% completion of onboarding tasks within 10 days, (2) <5% regression vs baseline on quality evals, (3) at least 2 actionable product requests per partner. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Ryan (CS): Add CS metrics: NPS > 7 on onboarding survey, response time SLA for blockers < 4 hours for first week. We'll schedule 30/60/90 check-ins.
Maya (PM): Those look good. Recruitment: prefer customers that already run heavy token volumes or need private infra. Sasha — can you draft screening questions? Liam — what's the minimum infra commit to guarantee capacity?
Sasha (Design): Draft screening snippet: ```1) Use-case summary (50–100 words) 2) Avg tokens/day 3) Privacy needs (VPC/on-prem) 4) Success metric you care about 5) Primary contact + cadence``` Will share a Google Form template in #product after lunch.
Liam (ProdOps): Minimum reserve: 2 x A100 equiv per partner for baseline tests, burst pool shared. If we get 8 partners that's within our Dedicated pilot budget. Need signing form for access window.
Alex (Eng): Implementation ask: we should prepare two routes: "prod-like" rollout (canary traffic routing) and a fully isolated instance. I'll write a short matrix of tradeoffs and a fallback policy snippet: ```if latency>SLO then route->quantized-variant```
Ryan (CS): For feedback loops: weekly short survey + bug report channel + scheduled deep-dive session end of week 3. I'll own scheduling and escalation. Also propose a small stipend or usage credit as incentive.
BetaBot: Reminder posted — please add recruit leads into the shared spreadsheet: https://redwood.example.com/sheets/dp-mini-cohort
Maya (PM): Next steps: Sasha to post screening form, Liam to finalize infra commit + access SLA, Alex to draft rollout/fallback matrix, Ryan to draft support cadence & incentive proposal. Let's reconvene Thu 10:30. @here any objections?
Sasha (Design): No objections. I'll drop the form and a one-pager for partners.
Alex (Eng): Fine with Thu. I'll attach the matrix before EOD Wed.
Liam (ProdOps): I'll circulate the access/legal checklist for partner sign-off.
Ryan (CS): I'll prepare the 30/60/90 check-in calendar and short survey.
Maya (PM): Great — thanks all. Quick ask: capture two example partner profiles (high-volume infra + regulated data) we can send to sales to scout. I'll draft examples and ping sales. :rocket:
